name: Factorio-Server-Control
description: A maintained modern fork of the original Factorio Server Manager (OpenFactorioServerManager). Operate one Factorio dedicated server through a responsive web interface with independent profiles, saves, fixed checkpoints, compatible mods and dependencies, profile-scoped mod startup settings, stable/experimental/exact game versions, base Factorio or Space Age, world creation, resource-aware factory-map snapshots with named platform detail, logs, users and safe server controls.

paths.name: Manager Data (required)
paths.description: Persistent manager database, UI users, configuration, logs, credentials, profiles, checkpoints and map snapshots. Never remove this mapping during an update.

paths.name: Mods (required)
paths.description: Persistent downloaded mods, built-in game-mode selection and mod-list.json.

paths.name: Config (required)
paths.description: Persistent Factorio server and map configuration.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port used to open the Factorio Server Control web interface.

ports.name: Factorio Game Port
ports.description: UDP port used by Factorio clients to connect to the game server.

variables.name: Initial Factorio Version
variables.description: Used only for the first installation: latest, stable or an exact version such as 2.1.14. Later UI choices are persisted across container updates.

variables.name: Maximum Upload Size
variables.description: Maximum size in MiB for one uploaded save, mod or mod pack.

variables.name: Secure Session Cookie
variables.description: Use false for Unraid's direct HTTP Web UI. Set true only when the manager is always opened through an HTTPS reverse proxy.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Optional internal Factorio RCON password. Leave empty to generate and persist a random password automatically.
